## Big idea

Spring gives you a pooled `DataSource` (often HikariCP) and `JdbcTemplate` so you write less JDBC glue.

```java
jdbcTemplate.update("insert into product(name,price) values(?,?)", name, price);
List<Product> list = jdbcTemplate.query("select * from product", mapper);
```

## Practice

1. Configure datasource properties.
2. Inject `JdbcTemplate`.
3. Re-implement product CRUD with it.

## Reasoning

Connection pools reuse connections — critical under load. Do not open a new raw connection per request in production code.
